scope: Sky cloud structure only. No terrain, UI, publishing or GPU render changes.

assessment.kloppenheim_06_puresky: Sparse separated cumulus and too much clean blue sky; weaker match to the continuous thin reference layers.
assessment.citrus_orchard_puresky: Natural irregular small structure, but larger clumps and brighter open blue patches.
assessment.citrus_orchard_road_puresky: Chosen: soft irregular layers and fine broken filaments in the 10–40 degree elevation sector.
assessment.industrial_sunset_puresky: Useful broad veil but comparatively heavy low cumulus. Full RGB is too cool, as with all candidates.

method.kind: Estimated scalar cloud coverage from chromatic ratios; not measured optical depth
method.runtime: 4K lossless WebP, NoColorSpace, 1.84MB; no source RGB
method.sourceSunRemoval: Source disk at altitude3.515625deg; scalar mask radius3–7deg; used forward field starts above12deg
method.illumination: Authored directional color gradient and shared oneSun preserved. Same sky material must feed water reflection and PMREM.
method.integration: const sky=createSky(...); await sky.readyPromise; capture PMREM only afterwards.
method.pmremTextureOwnership: After ShaderMaterial.clone(), reassign cloned uniforms.uCloudMap.value to the original texture object before rendering to avoid per-update GPU copies.

validation.hdrHashes: All downloaded 2K MD5 values and selected8K MD5 verified against primary API.
validation.sourcePreview: All4 sources and selected cloud sector visually inspected.
validation.dataPreview: Scalar map inspected; natural irregular structure survives extraction; lower hemisphere neutral, source sun masked.
validation.gpu: Not run by this agent. Final scene appearance, reflection, and shader compilation remain pending root GPU window.
